purpose: Portable public HOM-AIMOS authority. Paths are relative to the fork root and are resolved by the Genesis installer. Runtime state, credentials, identities, permissions, and memories are ledgered; no environment or private Oracle file hierarchy is authoritative.

governance.aladdin_retention: No decay, deletion, suppression, or deactivation. Only the explicit whole-brain legal purge ceremony may erase canonical memory.

genesis_corpus.binding: Every Guide genesis save signs this schema, version, corpus root, and its own file hash into provenance.

sequence: Reject .env files, dotenv, and environment-owned runtime authority
Verify or install the checksum-locked pgsodium 3.1.11 artifact set
Create the AIMOS database and restricted agent_runtime role
Ingest the eight Guide files through the signed native save route
Start HOM-AIMOS on its configured non-Oracle port only after readiness proof

memory_architecture.canonical_store: PostgreSQL append-only memory, provenance, envelope, credential, authorization, and event ledgers
memory_architecture.current_truth: explicit supersession relations over fully retained immutable versions

retrieval_stack.canonical_transport: signed POST routes/aimos.js and signed MCP protocol translators

service_inventory.counting_policy: top-level services/<group>/*.js excluding index.js barrels and hidden directories

sync_rules: hom-architecture-manifest.json must equal the live sorted service census
Guide changes require a new Genesis manifest root and append-only corpus upgrade ceremony
ARCHITECTURE-MAP.md must mirror the implemented public runtime
Oracle ports 9000 and 9001 are reserved and never belong to HOM-AIMOS
